name: rayspec
//files: `rayspec-release-identity.json` is a RELEASE artifact, not a source file: `scripts/release-identity.mjs` writes it into this directory during a release run and it is gitignored, so it is absent from a fresh checkout and npm silently skips a `files` entry that does not exist. Because it SURVIVES a release run, the release sequence removes it before packing — see the repo-root `//release-identity` note; generation refuses when a packed launcher already carries a manifest that is not the one it would write. Listing it here is what makes the release identity manifest ship inside the launcher tarball — the installed-package half of its reachability.
description: The unscoped `rayspec` launcher — a thin bin that hands control to the RaySpec CLI (`@rayspec/cli`). Installing `rayspec` (or `npx rayspec`) puts the `rayspec` command on PATH: `rayspec init` scaffolds a starter project, `rayspec doctor`/`plan` validate and preview a deploy, `rayspec deploy` serves it. All behavior lives in `@rayspec/cli`; this package only re-exposes its bin under the bare `rayspec` name.
